## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: helping teens and new drivers learn
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
The chapter points to a sample driving log on a following page, but no log appears in the extracted text of the selected pages; the log itself is not taught (verify TN-TEACH-D-LOG) [A02].
The teen first-year crash rates and the supervised-miles recommendation come from research the manual names without a year, so they are held as dated figures [A02].
The road test duration and the English requirement are stated as policy in a parents' note; they are taught as printed and flagged as dynamic [A03].

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 131 refers readers to a sample practice log on a later page, but no log text appears in physical pages 130 to 132; confirm whether the log exists as an image or a separate form before referring learners to it.
